bio.en:
Hi, I'm Dora! A girl who lives between the ocean and the forest, between melodies and daydreams.

When I'm not lost in a book or exploring virtual worlds, you'll find me at the piano — playing Chopin, Debussy, or just improvising whatever my heart feels like. Music is my favorite way to breathe.

I believe life is like a beautiful melody — sometimes gentle like ocean waves, sometimes lively like a forest breeze. Every day is a new page to fill with stories, laughter, and a little bit of magic.
bio.zh:
嗨，我是朵拉！一个生活在海洋和森林之间、旋律和白日梦之间的女孩。

不在书里迷路、不在虚拟世界探险的时候，你会发现我坐在钢琴前——弹肖邦、德彪西，或者随心所欲地即兴演奏。音乐是我最喜欢的呼吸方式。

我相信生活就像一首美妙的旋律——有时温柔如海浪，有时活泼如林间的微风。每一天都是新的一页，等着被故事、欢笑和一点点魔法填满。

text.en: I love exploring virtual worlds — from cozy life sims to epic adventures. Gaming is where I unwind, challenge myself, and live a thousand different lives.
text.zh: 我喜欢探索虚拟世界——从温馨的生活模拟到史诗级冒险。游戏是我放松、挑战自己、体验千种不同人生的地方。

text.en: The piano is my closest companion. Classical pieces fill my room on quiet afternoons — Debussy's moonlight, Chopin's nocturnes. Each note is a small world of its own.
text.zh: 钢琴是我最亲密的伙伴。安静的午后，古典乐曲充满整个房间——德彪西的月光、肖邦的夜曲。每一个音符都是一个小小的世界。

text.en: Books are portals to infinite worlds. I curl up with a good story whenever I can — fantasy, poetry, or anything that makes my imagination dance.
text.zh: 书是通往无限世界的传送门。只要有机会，我就会窝在一个角落里读一个好故事——奇幻、诗歌，或任何能让想象力起舞的东西。

caption.en: The world fades away when the music begins...
caption.zh: 当音乐响起，世界都安静了...

caption.en: One more level... okay, maybe ten more.
caption.zh: 再打一关……好吧，也许再打十关。

caption.en: Lost in a story, found in a dream.
caption.zh: 在故事里迷路，在梦里找到方向。

message.en: I'm so happy to make friends!
